title: # System Health
footer: > Silence longer than 2 days = red flag. This block belongs in every morning briefing.
commits_paused: {n} commits (push deliberately paused, no_push flag set)
llm_no_record: no record yet (waiting for an automation LLM call)
llm_auth: authentication error ({ago}): {detail}. Log in again with 'claude'
crm_auth: API token rejected ({ago}): {detail}. Refresh the token file
worker_no_trace: no {worker} trace in the last 100 commits
morning_ok: today's file exists and carries the health block
morning_no_block: today's file exists but has no health block (scheduled task may not have run)
morning_missing: not produced today (desktop app scheduled task, weekdays 07:00); the evening close-out will open the file
kill_ok: no breach, {due} due within {days} days, {missing} projects without criteria
